svg.title: AIcoach — Landing (Frame + Conversation)

text.tspan: AI
coach
Send one swing.
Hear what a coach
would tell you.
AIcoach watches one down-the-line clip from
your phone. It names the fault, shows you the
frame it comes from, and gives you one drill.
Then you can ask it why.
For golfers between +2 and 15 handicap who practise
at the range with a phone. Practice tool only.
Your hips are moving toward the
ball through impact. That’s early
extension, and I’m sure of it.
Why does it feel like I’m
staying down when I’m not?

g.text: It happens below your eye line.
Answers are based only on this analysis.

text.tspan: The coach talks.
The frame shows it.
Every number the coach says is pinned to the
swing. Tap a pin, or let the coach cite it, and the
stage jumps to that frame and lights the point it
measured.

svg.text: Plain language, one feel cue, no jargon.
Numbers only come from your clip.
A likely cause is pointed to, not measured.
One swing fits inside a range session.
Film on your phone, send the clip from the browser, read the answer before your next ball.

text.tspan: Your hips moved
toward the ball.
Down the line, phone at hand height, 2.4–3.7 m
behind your hands.
mp4 or mov, max 15 s. The clip is deleted after
analysis unless you save it.
One fault, one drill, one mobility exercise.
Then ask the coach why.

svg.text: Three faults, checked against a fixed rule table.
If your swing shows something else, the coach says “No verified fault found”. It does not force one onto you.

text.tspan: Hips move toward the ball, address → impact
Drill:
Wall drill
Posture angle change, downswing vs address
Drill:
Alignment-stick head drill
Hand path in transition above the backswing path
Drill:
Pump drill

svg.text: Capped at medium: measured from hand path, no club tracking.
When it can’t tell, it says so.
Three real answers the coach gives instead of guessing.
I won’t guess from this clip. Here’s why:

text.tspan: None of my three rules fired on Nelly’s
swing, so I won’t prescribe a drill.
Weight appears to move toward the
trail side at the top.

svg.text: Should I change my grip too?

text.tspan: I didn’t measure your grip in this clip,
so I can’t tell you. What I did measure
is your hips:

svg.text: Answers are based only on this analysis —
no new faults, numbers or drills.
Your coach is waiting for one swing.
Create an account, film a down-the-line clip, and read the answer at the range.
Your swing clips are private. Unsaved clips are deleted after analysis. Delete your account any time.
AIcoach is a practice tool — not for use during a competitive round. Mobility exercises are generic guidance, not medical advice.
